import csv, hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile
site = pathlib.Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
binding = pathlib.Path('products/distribution/catalogue-referral/item-4-release-binding.json')
output = pathlib.Path('products/services/catalogue-text-fulfillment/fixture-execution.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
result = {'scope': 'Offline fixture execution only. No customer delivery or order.', 'binding_sha256': hashlib.sha256(binding.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'runs': {}}
try:
    verifier, = site.rglob('verify_example.py')
    fixture, = site.rglob('before-supplier.csv')
    def run(args, cwd):
        observed = subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=20)
        return {'argv': args, 'exit': observed.returncode, 'stdout': observed.stdout, 'stderr': observed.stderr}
    result['runs']['clean_control'] = run([sys.executable, verifier.name], verifier.parent)
    with fixture.open(encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as source:
        reader = csv.DictReader(source)
        rows = list(reader)
        headers = reader.fieldnames or []
    result['input_headers'] = headers
    result['input_rows'] = len(rows)
    transform, = site.rglob('transform.py')
    result['runs']['transform_usage'] = run([sys.executable, transform.name, '--help'], transform.parent)
    images = [header for header in headers if 'image' in header.lower() and any(row.get(header, '').startswith('https://') for row in rows)]
    styles = [header for header in headers if header.lower().strip().replace('_', ' ') in ('style', 'style id', 'style code', 'style number')]
    candidates = []
    if len(images) == len(styles) == 1:
        image, style = images[0], styles[0]
        for position, row in enumerate(rows):
            for other in rows[position+1:]:
                if row[style] and row[style] == other[style] and row[image].startswith('https://') and other[image].startswith('https://') and row[image] != other[image]:
                    candidates.append((row, other))
    if candidates:
        first, second = candidates[0]
        second[image] = first[image]
        result['changed_style'] = first[style]
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as sandbox:
            changed = pathlib.Path(sandbox) / 'duplicate-image.csv'
            with changed.open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
                writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=headers)
                writer.writeheader()
                writer.writerows(rows)
            result['changed_input_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(changed.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            result['runs']['duplicate_image'] = run([sys.executable, transform.name, str(changed), str(pathlib.Path(sandbox) / 'after.csv')], transform.parent)
    else:
        result['remaining_check'] = 'Use the saved headers and usage to construct a supported duplicate-image fixture manually.'
except (ValueError, OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
    result['execution_error'] = str(error)
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
